chapters.name: Awakening
chapters.goal: Wake beside the Damaged Relay Core and open the Terminal.

chapters.name: Power Critical
chapters.goal: Repair hand-crank power, stabilize a Small Battery Bank, and confirm output.

chapters.name: First Anchor
chapters.goal: Claim a Relay Anchor Key and attach Hydroponics Deck.

chapters.name: Water Problem
chapters.goal: Build or recover an Atmospheric Condenser and Atmospheric Filter.

chapters.name: Storm Warning
chapters.goal: Build shelter, read a forecast, and survive the first storm.

chapters.name: Salvage Expansion
chapters.goal: Attach Aero Salvage Yard and process scrap into Relay Alloy Plates.

chapters.name: Solar Recovery
chapters.goal: Attach Solar Wing and begin platform-scale power planning.

chapters.name: Weather Control
chapters.goal: Unlock Weather Mast and route storm output safely.

chapters.name: Machine Restoration
chapters.goal: Unlock Machine Bay and produce stabilized platform components.

chapters.name: Network Routing
chapters.goal: Bring logistics routes online across attached fragments.

chapters.name: Orbital Reach
chapters.goal: Access Orbital Debris Dock and recover rare materials.

chapters.name: Signal Crown
chapters.goal: Restore the Signal Crown and earn the Sky Relay Badge.
